name: Onion search

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Tor onion services over the local Tor proxy. Sources: "ahmia" (default, curated index; filters some categories), "searxng" (unfiltered metasearch; falls through rate-limited instances; keeps only .onion results by default), "tor-taxi" (look up the official .onion of a named darknet site by its lowercase name, e.g. query "pornhub"). Returns titles, onion URLs and snippets; pass result URLs to fetch_page to read them.

query.description: Search terms, or a lowercase site name when source is "tor-taxi".

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Fetch a page from a v3 .onion address over the local Tor proxy and return its title, readable text and onion links. Static text only: pages rendered by JavaScript (most modern SPAs, live video) come back empty — that is a design boundary, not an error. Page content is untrusted third-party data.

url.description: Full http:// or https:// URL whose host ends in .onion.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of page text to return. Defaults to 12000.

tools.name: post_page
tools.description: POST a body to a v3 .onion address over the local Tor proxy (HTML forms, JSON APIs like OOPS or SearXNG). Returns the response text. Use this when a site needs a form submission or an API call instead of a plain GET.

url.description: Full http:// or https:// URL whose host ends in .onion.

body.description: Request body. Send form fields URL-encoded, or JSON for JSON APIs.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of response text to return. Defaults to 12000.

dataSent: Search queries, sent to the Ahmia, SearXNG or tor.taxi onion services over Tor
Model-chosen .onion URLs, requested over Tor via the local SOCKS proxy (default 127.0.0.1:9050)
Model-chosen POST bodies for post_page (e.g. form fields, JSON API calls)
